newsitem.title: FINLAND: Finland to offer 2 mln extra Kemira shares.
newsitem.headline: Finland to offer 2 mln extra Kemira shares.

text.p: Finland will offer two million extra shares to private investors in chemicals firm Kemira Oy as the first four million offered were all sold on the first day, the ministry of trade and industry (KTM) said on Wednesday.

"Since the four million shares on offer have already been sold today, the ministry of trade and industry has decided to raise the amount of shares offered by two million according to the offer terms," it said.
The state's offering was priced at 49.50 markka on Tuesday at the end of an offering of 17 million shares to institutional investors -- five million new shares and 12 million of the state's stock.
Private investors get one bonus share for each 10 they buy if they keep them for 12 months.

So the total amount offered will rise to 19 million shares, and the lead managers also have an option to increase the issue of new shares by three million, which would raise the total to 21 million shares. @
If that option were exercised and all shares sold, the state's stake in Kemira would fall to slightly above 54 percent, a trade and industry ministry official said.
Kemira ended official hours at 50.30 markka, down 1.20.
